title: FATHER GOD, LET YOUR LIGHT SHINE ON MY DAY
text: I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are this morning. Whether you are in your room, in your car, in your office, or wherever the spirit of [music] God has found you at this hour, I want you to lift up your hands unto the Lord. This is not just another prayer session. This is a divine intersection [music] between heaven and your reality. This is where the supernatural invades the natural. [music] This is where the light of God's countenance begins to shine upon the trajectory of your life. Open your mouth right now and begin to worship him. Begin [music] to magnify his name. Tell him, "Lord, I honor you this morning. I acknowledge your sovereignty over my life. I acknowledge your [music] lordship over every circumstance that concerns me." We are asking for the light of his glory to rest upon every dimension of our lives. You see, when God said in Genesis 1:3, "Let there be light." Darkness had no choice but to bow. This is the priestly benediction that was pronounced upon the children of Israel. And I want you to notice [music] something powerful here. The blessing is progressive. First God blesses you. When the face of God shines [music] upon you, you enter into a realm of divine favor that cannot be explained by human reasoning. When his face shines upon you, you walk in supernatural favor. You walk in uncommon grace. You walk in dimensions of blessing that defy natural explanation. I pray [music] for somebody right now in the name of Jesus Christ. From this day forward, the light of God's [music] face shall shine upon you. Say, "The light of God shines upon me. I walk in divine favor. I walk in supernatural grace. I am a carrier of God's glory. Everywhere I go, the light in me dispels darkness. The glory upon me attracts divine opportunities. Now, I want you to understand that light has specific functions in the realm of the spirit. First of all, light exposes. [music] Ephesians 5:13 says, "But all things that are exposed are made manifest by the light. For whatever [music] makes manifest is light." When you ask God to let his light shine on your day, you are asking [music] him to expose every hidden trap. You are asking him to reveal every concealed enemy. You are asking him to uncover every secret, manipulation. The enemy operates best in darkness. He thrives in [music] secrecy. He functions in hiddenness.
